categories.main_business_segments: Yangzhou Yangjie Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the power semiconductor industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor devices, chips, and silicon wafers. Its main product lines include materials (single crystal silicon rods, wafers, epitaxial wafers), wafers (5-inch, 6-inch, 8-inch silicon-based and 6-inch silicon carbide power electronic device chips), and packaged devices (MOSFET, IGBT, SiC series, rectifiers, protection devices, small signal and other product series). The company serves emerging markets such as automotive electronics, AI servers, robotics, 5G communications, clean energy, smart security, industrial control, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) and Fabless hybrid models, integrating single crystal silicon manufacturing, chip design and manufacturing, device packaging and testing, and end sales and services. It has advanced R&D platforms including a central research institute and multiple specialized teams for SiC, IGBT, MOSFET, and other semiconductor technologies. The company emphasizes digital transformation, lean manufacturing, and automation technologies such as MES, PLC, and EAP to enhance production efficiency and quality. It also invests heavily in third-generation semiconductors like SiC and GaN, with proprietary chip fabrication and module assembly lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include top-tier clients in automotive electronics, AI servers, robotics, photovoltaic energy, energy storage, industrial automation, and 5G communications. The company has established strategic partnerships with leading global customers and has achieved multiple international Tier 1 certifications. It targets both domestic and international markets with differentiated brands, serving OEMs and system integrators requiring high-performance power semiconductor components.
categories.geographic_coverage: Yangjie Technology operates globally with a strong presence in China and Asia-Pacific regions, and expanding footprint in Europe and North America. It has established localized R&D, manufacturing, and sales networks in multiple countries including Vietnam, the United States, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and Taiwan. The company’s 'YJ' brand focuses on domestic and Asia-Pacific markets, while the 'MCC' brand targets Europe and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates vertically integrated along the semiconductor power device supply chain, covering upstream single crystal silicon manufacturing, midstream wafer fabrication and chip design, and downstream device packaging, testing, and sales. It combines IDM and Fabless models to maintain control over core technologies and production processes, enabling end-to-end supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on product leadership, operational excellence, and global expansion. R&D priorities include advancing third-generation semiconductors (SiC, GaN), automotive-grade MOSFETs, IGBTs, and power modules. It invests in expanding global R&D centers, enhancing digital and lean manufacturing capabilities, and developing comprehensive product portfolios for automotive electronics, clean energy, AI servers, and industrial automation. The company also emphasizes innovation in packaging technologies and collaborates with universities and research institutes to accelerate technology breakthroughs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor devices, chips, and silicon wafers. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels, with a significant portion of sales through direct customer engagement and strategic partnerships. It also derives income from licensing and investment returns related to equity holdings in semiconductor-related enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yangjie Technology is positioned as a leading domestic power semiconductor company in China, ranked among the top three in the Chinese semiconductor power device sector and within the top twenty globally. It competes with international giants such as ON Semiconductor, Infineon, and Analog Devices, particularly in MOSFET, IGBT, and SiC markets. The company leverages its vertical integration, technology innovation, and localized global presence to strengthen its competitive position and accelerate import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 6.03 billion, representing an 11.53% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 1.00 billion, up 8.5% from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 14.27 billion, growing 13.03% year-over-year. R&D expenses accounted for over 7% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. Cash flow from operations increased significantly by 54.76%, indicating robust operational performance and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yangjie Technology emphasizes a comprehensive one-stop solution capability integrating silicon material production, chip design, manufacturing, packaging, and sales. Its value proposition centers on delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and technologically advanced power semiconductor products with rapid delivery and strong customer service. The company differentiates itself through its IDM+Fabless hybrid model, extensive R&D investment, advanced manufacturing automation, and multi-brand strategy tailored for different global markets. It also focuses on accelerating domestic high-end semiconductor substitution and expanding its presence in emerging sectors like automotive electronics and AI.
